Mike (Sales): quick pass to CS — Plymore signed today, mid-market telco analytics. Contract: 6mo Dedicated trial (reserved capacity), starts 2026-05-04. Main asks: Okta SAML, VPC peering (private deploy option), and weekly cost reports. Renewal intent is positive but they need a clear onboarding runway.
Elaine (CS): thanks Mike — assigning owners and next steps inline.
Elaine (CS): owners: SSO & onboarding runbook = @Tori (Enablement); infra/network = @Samir (Support); billing/contract follow-up = Mike.
Tori (Enablement): got it — I'll prepare a 60min enablement for their platform and 30min admin SSO walk. Prefer Wed 5/6 or Fri 5/8 PST. Need customer Okta admin email and an SP metadata file.
Mike (Sales): sharing Okta admin: lina@plymore.com. I'll send metadata once they confirm time.
Samir (Support): I'll kick off VPC peering questionnaire. Quick Q: do they want VPC-to-VPC peering or private link? Any reqs for egress filtering?
Elaine (CS): they asked for peering with controlled egress, want to restrict outbound to our egress IPs. Samir, I can DM the network contact: ciso@plymore.com.
Samir (Support): perfect. I'll create an infra ticket and request PoC subnet ranges + firewall rules. ETA to share initial diagram: EOW (2026-05-01).
Tori (Enablement): prep checklist for enablement: 1) SSO test account + SP metadata, 2) sample dataset for template prompts, 3) list of 3 pilot use-cases, 4) contact list for admins. Can you confirm sample data scope, Mike?
Mike (Sales): will confirm sample dataset — they prefer anonymized logs and 10k rows. I'll ask for pilot use-cases in same thread.
Elaine (CS): risks: renewal risk low but watch for delays on SSO/VPC. We should set a milestone cadence: Week 0 onboarding call, Week 1 SSO test, Week 2 peering PoC, Week 4 pilot run. Any objections?
Samir (Support): sounds good. I'll add the timeline to the infra ticket and flag required review windows for security.
Tori (Enablement): I'll draft the enablement slide deck and internal runbook. Share any customer-specific prompts and examples here.
Mike (Sales): sharing pilot use-cases from customer: 1) anonymized incident summarization, 2) call transcript tagging, 3) automated alert triage.
Elaine (CS): thanks. Action items (owners): - Tori: enablement session + runbook (due 2026-05-05) - Samir: infra ticket + peering diagram (due 2026-05-01) - Mike: SP metadata & sample dataset (due 2026-04-30) - Elaine: kickoff + weekly status updates (starts 2026-05-04).
Deploy Bot: scheduled meeting created by @Elaine for "Plymore onboarding kickoff" — 2026-05-04 09:00 PST. Calendar invites sent.
Mike (Sales): noted, I'll be on the kickoff. Anything else we should surface to legal or compliance?
Elaine (CS): legal to review data processing addendum (DPA) — I have a checklist; will loop in @legal on Tue if Samir confirms network posture.
Samir (Support): updating ticket with security checklist now. Will ping @Elaine when the draft is ready.
Tori (Enablement): once I have Okta SP metadata I can run a dry SSO test in staging. Please push metadata to me or paste the XML here.
Mike (Sales): I'll follow up with Lina and post the metadata here when I get it.
Elaine (CS): great team — I'll post a weekly status snapshot in this thread after kickoff. :raised_hands:
Mike (Sales): thanks all :thumbsup:
Samir (Support): moving infra items to triage board now.
Tori (Enablement): prepping training notes, will attach the link to the slide deck in this thread.
